# Ally X final benchmark - per-run checklist (generated by gen_checklist.py; edit the generator, not this file)

Rule: game-side only. No TDP / governor / env var / gamescope change. Same save, same spot, same camera sweep for every run (`notes/final-benchmark-protocol.md`). Tool order per run: `cfgswitch.sh` (graphics) -> ini/shaders -> launch -> `run_log.sh tag ID VARIANT PRESET` -> `run_log.sh run [combat]` -> screenshot if `shot` -> close game -> restore ALL-OFF.

## A. Session preflight (once)

- [ ] `./run_log.sh install` done, overlay visible in game; Shift_L+F2 starts/stops a log (or mapped in Steam Input)
- [ ] `export NIOH3_DIR=<game folder>`; `./cfgswitch.sh path` prints the config.xml; `./cfgswitch.sh backup session-start`
- [ ] `./ally_shaders.sh status all` (gpu-shaders) = nothing applied; ini = ALL-OFF (`matrix.json` `alloff`)
- [ ] Fixed for the whole session and written here: DISP_MODE ____ SCR_REZ 1920x1080 REN_FPS ____ VSYNC ____ DYNAMIC_RESOLUTION ____ RESOLUTION_SCALING ____ FRAME_GENERATION OFF  power mode/TDP ____ (record only, do not change)
- [ ] Battery: plugged in / ____ %; room temp ____ C; cool start (fan idle) before each BASE
- [ ] Temps are logged automatically (MangoHud cpu_temp/gpu_temp -> `summary_ally_hw.csv`); also note the Steam/Bazzite overlay reading on the first run of each section

Per-run columns: `done`; `tag` = `run_log.sh tag <ID> <VARIANT> <PRESET>`; stand x2, move x1, combat x1 where marked; `shot` = same-view screenshot; `temps` = peak CPU/GPU C written from the summary.

## F. Input latency (`latency_procedure.md`)

- [ ] STOCK: clip filmed (24 presses), `run_log.sh tag LAT_STOCK STOCK USER; run_log.sh window lat`, frames counted into latency.csv
- [ ] OPTIMIZED: clip filmed (24 presses), `run_log.sh tag LAT_OPTIMIZED OPTIMIZED USER; run_log.sh window lat`, frames counted into latency.csv
- [ ] OPTIMIZED_FG: clip filmed (24 presses), `run_log.sh tag LAT_OPTIMIZED_FG OPTIMIZED_FG USER; run_log.sh window lat`, frames counted into latency.csv
- [ ] STOCK repeated, medians agree within 1 frame; `python3 latency_calc.py latency.csv` saved

## G. Stability (the user plays; recommended setup)

- [ ] Session start: time ____, config.xml backup `stability-start`, ini hash ____
- [ ] Crashes / hangs: ____ (copy `Nioh3EngineFix.log` tail + the game exit code from the Steam/proton log)
- [ ] Session end: duration ____ h; peak temps ____; MangoHud one long log (`window load`)
